Investments — Transactions

The Investment Transactions screen shows all transactions that affect the quantity of units you hold in a specific investment.

This comprehensive view helps you track how your investment holdings change over time through purchases, sales, and other adjustments.

Transaction Information

Each transaction displays essential details including the date, description, quantity change, and your balance after the transaction.

Common transaction types include purchases (which increase your holdings), sales (which decrease them), and various adjustments that may affect your position.

Reading the Transaction List

Transactions appear in chronological order, making it easy to follow the history of your investment.

The running balance column shows your total units held after each transaction, providing a clear picture of your position at any point in time.
